result.stdout:
USAGE:
    craftsman add [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

EXAMPLES:
    craftsman add entity my/file/path.yaml
    craftsman add entity my/file/path.yml
    craftsman add entity my/file/path.json
    craftsman add bc my/file/path.yaml
    craftsman add bc my/file/path.yml

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help    Prints help information

COMMANDS:
    entity <Filepath>        Add one or more new entities to your Wrapt project 
                             using a formatted yaml or json file                
    bc <Filepath>            Scaffolds a new bounded context for a Wrapt domain 
                             project based on a given template file in a json or
                             yaml format                                        
    feature                  Scaffolds out a new feature using CLI prompts      
    bus                      Adds a message bus to your web api and a messages  
                             directory to your shared kernel using a formatted  
                             yaml or json file. A template file is optional     
    authserver <Filepath>    Adds a Duende based auth server project to your    
                             solution using a formatted yaml or json file       
    consumer <Filepath>      Add a receive endpoint and register it with        
                             MassTransit using a formatted yaml or json file    
    producer <Filepath>      Adds a distinct feature that produces a message and
                             registers it with MassTransit using a formatted    
                             yaml or json file                                  
    message <Filepath>       Adds one or more messages to your Shared Kernel    
                             project using a formatted yaml or json file        
    next
